tools.name: get_screen_info
tools.description: Return the real screen resolution and current mouse cursor position. Call this before clicking so you know the coordinate space.

tools.name: move_mouse
tools.description: Move the mouse cursor to a screen position (real screen pixels). If the coordinate came from a downscaled screenshot, also pass image_size so the tool converts it.

duration.description: Optional seconds to glide the cursor (default 0 = instant).

image_size.description: Optional [width, height] of the screenshot the coordinate was read from. The tool converts to real pixels.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click the mouse. Clicks at (x, y) if given, otherwise at the current cursor position. Supports left/right/middle and multiple clicks.

clicks.description: Number of clicks, e.g. 2 for a double click (default 1).

image_size.description: Optional [width, height] of the screenshot the coordinate was read from. The tool converts to real pixels.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type a string of text at the current focus (as keyboard input). For ASCII text the tool first switches the Windows IME to direct/alphanumeric input so a kana IME does not garble letters. Non-ASCII/IME text may still not enter correctly.

force_english.description: Force the IME to direct/alphanumeric input before typing. Defaults to true when the text is plain ASCII; set false to keep the current IME mode.

restore_ime.description: Restore the previous IME mode (e.g. kana) after typing. Default false (leave it in direct input).

tools.name: press_keys
tools.description: Press a key or a hotkey combo. Use 'enter', 'tab', 'esc' for single keys, or 'ctrl+c', 'alt+tab' for combos. An array of key names also works.

keys.description: A single key name, a '+'-joined combo like 'ctrl+c', or an array of key names.
